CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.active_duration_ms, COALESCE(SUM(r.end_active_ms - r.start_active_ms), 0) AS recognized_duration_ms, s.active_duration_ms - COALESCE(SUM(r.end_active_ms - r.start_active_ms), 0) AS unclassified_duration_ms FROM session s LEFT JOIN recognition_segment r ON r.session_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.active_duration_ms
